slides.purpose: Quantify the impact: prove that structured prompting delivers measurable gains
slides.content_brief: Title the slide 'What structured prompting saves'. Three-stat card slide showing token cost reduction (30-50%), output consistency improvement (up to 40%), and typical iteration cycles to production quality (3-5 rounds)
slides.assumes: Audience now knows the techniques and wants evidence they work
slides.hands_off: The gains from structured prompting are large and well-documented
